question: What mantra is proclaimed as belonging to the goddess Ṣaṣṭhī?
premises: A mantra is described as eight-syllabled
That mantra is called a great mantra
It is proclaimed as belonging to the goddess Ṣaṣṭhī
inference: The eight-syllabled great mantra is proclaimed as the mantra of the goddess Ṣaṣṭhī.
plain_english: The eight-syllabled great mantra of the goddess Ṣaṣṭhī is proclaimed.
